### The Call for Repentance
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/call-repentance
Passage: Joel 2:12-27
Points:
- God summons His people to genuine inward repentance and soul conversion rather than mere external displays of mourning.
- The invitation to return is anchored in the Lord's gracious character, patience, and willingness to relent from judgment.
- The need to turn back to God is urgent and comprehensive, requiring the participation of the whole community without exception.
- True repentance approaches God with confidence in His promised mercy while maintaining deep humility that never presumes upon grace.
